qwen36_batch_ubatch.setup: Four requests with real code: 8,000 new tokens; 32,000 new tokens; generate 260 tokens with 32,000 tokens already cached; add 8,000 tokens over those 32,000. Temporary router, shared GPU memory.

qwen36_vs_context_depth.setup: Filling a 262,144-token window with four large messages (documents), each processed on top of the previous context; speed is the server's average for the new chunk. Production router.

qwen38_vs_context_depth.setup: From the server log of the cache test (76 requests of >= 1,500 tokens).

production_warm_8k_32k.note: Warm, production router, dedicated memory (2026-10-25). Temporary routers with shared memory give ~700-960 tok/s at 8K.
